description: This file defines a 'confchange' package implementing configuration change management for a Raft consensus system, including methods for entering and leaving joint configurations, applying changes, and managing voters and learners.

classes.name: Changer
classes.description: A class facilitating configuration changes in a Raft consensus group, supporting joint consensus transitions, voter and learner management, and validation.

methods.name: EnterJoint
methods.description: Transitions the configuration into a joint state with an outgoing config, copying the current voters to the outgoing config.

methods.name: LeaveJoint
methods.description: Transitions out of a joint configuration, promoting the incoming config as the sole configuration and updating learners.

methods.name: Simple
methods.description: Applies a series of configuration changes that mutate the incoming majority config by at most one node.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies individual configuration changes such as add, remove, or promote nodes.

methods.name: makeVoter
methods.description: Adds or promotes a node to be a voter.

methods.name: makeLearner
methods.description: Makes a node a learner or stages it for addition after leaving joint state.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a node from voters or learners.

methods.name: initProgress
methods.description: Initializes a new progress record for a node or learner.

methods.name: checkInvariants
methods.description: Validates configuration and progress map consistency.

methods.name: checkAndCopy
methods.description: Creates copies of current config and progress map for safe mutation.

methods.name: checkAndReturn
methods.description: Validates config and progress, returning error if invalid.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Returns zero values with an error.

methods.name: nilAwareAdd
methods.description: Adds an ID to a map, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: nilAwareDelete
methods.description: Deletes an ID from a map, nil'ing the map if empty.

methods.name: symdiff
methods.description: Counts the symmetric difference between two sets of node IDs.
